name: Blockchain Cryptography & Consensus Core
description: Cryptographic foundations, digital signatures (ECDSA, Ed25519, BLS), key derivation, wallet mechanics, token economics, hard/soft forks, and advanced consensus algorithms.

subskills.name: Asymmetric Cryptography & Digital Signatures
subskills.description: Elliptic curve cryptography (secp256k1, Ed25519, BLS signature aggregation), public/private key pairs, and signature verification (ecrecover).

subskills.name: Hierarchical Deterministic (HD) Wallets & Key Derivation
subskills.description: BIP-39 mnemonic seeds, BIP-32/BIP-44 derivation paths, multisig wallet schemes, and Shamir Secret Sharing.

subskills.name: Tokenomics Fundamentals & Emission Schedules
subskills.description: Inflationary vs deflationary token models, burn mechanisms (EIP-1559), staking yields, vesting schedules, and supply caps.

subskills.name: Validator Economics, Slashing & Staking
subskills.description: Proof of Stake validator duties, attestation rewards, slashing conditions (double signing, surround voting), and effective balance mechanics.

subskills.name: Network Forks & Protocol Upgrades
subskills.description: Hard forks vs soft forks, backward compatibility, chain splits, replay protection, and social consensus governance.

subskills.name: Sybil Resistance Mechanisms (PoW, PoS, PoA)
subskills.description: Comparative analysis of Sybil defenses: Proof of Work hash rate, Proof of Stake capital locking, and Proof of Authority reputation.

subskills.name: Advanced Consensus Algorithms (Tendermint, PoH, Avalanche)
subskills.description: Tendermint Core (PBFT-derived), Solana Proof of History (VDF sequencing), Avalanche Snow family DAG consensus, and Casper FFG/LMD-GHOST.

subskills.name: Zero-Knowledge Proof Foundations (zk-SNARKs & zk-STARKs)
subskills.description: Cryptographic zero-knowledge foundations: arithmetic circuits, R1CS, QAP, pairing cryptography, trusted setups vs transparent STARKs.

subskills.name: State Machine Replication & Deterministic Execution
subskills.description: Deterministic state transitions, world state trie transitions, EVM state rollback semantics, and multi-validator state synchronization.
